channel.title: Applied Linguistics — Calls for Papers & Conferences
channel.description: Aggregated, filtered feed of calls for papers and conference announcements relevant to applied linguistics, crawled and pulled from LINGUIST List, Ling Alert, WikiCFP and other sources.

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 9th Second-Language Learning and Disabilities International Conference
item.description: Join us for the 9th Second-Language Learning and Disabilities Conference, an online event dedicated to promoting inclusion and diversity in world language education. This year's conference invites educators, researchers, and practitioners to explore how we can create learning environments that recognize learner variability, challenge ableism and other forms of exclusion, and support meaningful participation for all students. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: The Journal on Ethnopolitics and Minority Issues in Europe - "Special Issue: Kurdish and European Minority Language Translation in Dialogue" (Jrnl)
item.description: Translation into and out of minority languages in Europe and the Middle East operates under conditions of asymmetric institutional recognition, fragmented standardization, and uneven access to publication and broadcast infrastructures. For Kurdish communities across Iran, Iraq, Turkey, and Syria, as well as in European diasporas, translation constitutes a site where language policy, state power, and minority identity converge. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: Journal of Experimental Pragmatics
item.description: We are delighted to announce that the Journal of Experimental Pragmatics is now live! A new community owned, Diamond Open Access journal dedicated to research on meaning, inference, communication, and language use in context. Built by and for the research community, JXPrag combines transparent peer review, a novel Voluntary Action Editor model, and free publishing for authors. item.description: We invite you to submit a paper or a book review to the journal Theoretical and Applied Linguistics@ro, edited by the Department of Linguistics of the Faculty of Letters (University of Bucharest) in collaboration with Bucharest University Press. TAL@ro is designed as a comprehensive and dynamic platform aimed at sparking debates and facilitating dialogue among scholars in various linguistic disciplines (e.g. phonetics, morphology, syntax, lexicology, semantics, pragmatics, sociolinguistics, etc.
